metadata.name: midrip
metadata.description: Mid-Rip: buy the sealed rest of a card pack mid-rip

instructions.name: abandon_stale
docs: Anyone can close a pack whose holder walked away. The unrevealed cards are forfeited, and the
randomness is published so the whole pack can still be checked against its commitment.

instructions.name: buy_rest
docs: Any other player buys the sealed rest at the clock price of the current slot.

instructions.name: callback_draw
docs: VRF callback: draw the pack into the private sealed account and publish only a commitment.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Only MagicBlock's VRF program can sign as this identity, so spoofed randomness is rejected.

instructions.name: claim_cards
docs: Mint the cards a player has withdrawn (as last committed to Solana) and not yet claimed.

accounts.name: player
docs: delegated, by the delegation program); deserialized and checked in the handler.

instructions.name: create_sealed_permission
docs: Make the sealed account private with no readers. Idempotent.

instructions.name: expire_listing
docs: Anyone can close a listing whose clock ran out unsold; the holder keeps ripping.

instructions.name: init_mint
docs: One SPL mint per rarity, minted only by this program.

instructions.name: list_rest
docs: The holder puts the still-sealed rest on a falling price clock.

instructions.name: open_pack
docs: Pay for a pack and ask MagicBlock VRF for its randomness before anything is shown.

instructions.name: refund_stuck
docs: If the VRF callback never arrives, refund the opener and free the table.

instructions.name: reveal
docs: The holder reveals the next sealed card; the card goes to whoever holds the pack now.

instructions.name: sell_cards
docs: Sell cards back at 100% of their published table value.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Commit the public table and any player accounts passed as remaining accounts to Solana.

instructions.name: settle_and_undelegate
docs: Commit and hand the public table and player accounts back to Solana.

instructions.name: settle_players
docs: Commit only player accounts to Solana (for tables past MagicBlock's 10-commit cap).

instructions.name: withdraw_cards
docs: Take cards out of play so they can be claimed as SPL tokens on Solana after the next settle.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the admin can do this

errors.name: TableBusy
errors.msg: This table already has a pack in play

errors.name: WrongState
errors.msg: Wrong table state for this action

errors.name: NotHolder
errors.msg: Only the current holder of the pack can do this

fields.name: withdrawn
docs: Cards taken out of play to be minted as SPL tokens on Solana; only ever grows.

types.name: Sealed
docs: Private on the rollup (permission with no readers): the drawn pack.

types.name: Table
docs: Public pack header: anyone can read it.

fields.name: randomness
docs: Zero until the pack is finished, then the VRF randomness for verification.
